lines.en: label dormwar6:
scene knowledge1
: Ladies and gentlemen! Friends and family! Molly!
lines.zh: : 女士们先生们！亲朋好友们！还有 Molly！

lines.en: : WHY?!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！

lines.en: : The time has come for one of the most heated matchups in all of the first annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War!
lines.zh: : 首届超级无敌究极宿舍大战中最激烈的对决之一，时刻已到！

lines.en: : Wait, wasn’t it “Super Ultimate Mega?”
lines.zh: : 等等，不是“超级究极无敌”吗？

lines.en: : No! Get with the fucking program, Ami!
lines.zh: : 不是！搞清楚状况行不行，Ami！

lines.en: : My bad...
lines.zh: : 我的错……

lines.en: scene knowledge2
: Today’s contest will be conducted trivia style!
lines.zh: : 今天的比赛采用知识问答的形式！

lines.en: : Each team has selected several smart person question thingies designed to stump the member of the other team!
lines.zh: : 每队都准备了几个“聪明人问题”，目的就是难倒对方队伍的选手！

lines.en: : The contestants have {i}not{/i} been included in the selection of their opponent’s questions!
lines.zh: : 参赛选手{i}没有{/i}参与对手题目的出题环节！

lines.en: : In the event of a tie, Makoto and Nodoka will arm wrestle to determine who the winner is!
lines.zh: : 如果出现平局，Makoto 和 Nodoka 将用掰手腕决出胜负！

lines.en: : Don’t let her lick you, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 别让她舔到你，Makoto！

lines.en: : First off, it won’t come down to a tie.
lines.zh: : 首先，根本不会打到平局。

lines.en: : Secondly, I highly doubt Nodoka would employ the same strategy as Kirin when it comes to an arm wrestling match.
lines.zh: : 其次，我严重怀疑 Nodoka 在掰手腕时会采用和 Kirin 一样的策略。

lines.en: : I mean...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be {i}opposed{/i} to licking you.
lines.zh: : 我倒也不{i}介意{/i}舔你。

lines.en: : See?! It’s a real strategy now!
lines.zh: : 看吧？！这现在已经是正经战术了！

lines.en: : Silence!
lines.zh: : 安静！

lines.en: : Ami! Please do the honors of introducing today’s combatants!
lines.zh: : Ami！有请你来介绍今天的参赛选手！

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh, okay. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，好的。行。

lines.en: scene knowledge3
: Representing the first floor is Makoto Miyamura!
lines.zh: : 代表一楼出战的是 Makoto Miyamura！

lines.en: : Her favorite subjects are math and science and she enjoys taking long walks on the beach and candlelit dinners!
lines.zh: : 她最喜欢的科目是数学和科学，爱好是在海滩上散步和烛光晚餐！

lines.en: : A fun fact about her is that she has webbed toes!
lines.zh: : 关于她的一个趣闻是，她的脚趾是连在一起的！

lines.en: scene knowledge4
: I do not! And don’t just make up random facts about me as part of my introduction!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！别在我的介绍里随便编些关于我的事实！

lines.en: : I’ll still love you no matter what kinda deformities ya have, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 不管你有什么样的畸形，我都会一样爱你的，Makoto！

lines.en: : I don’t have any deformities! Just get on with the competition! This is ruining my focus!
lines.zh: : 我没有任何畸形！赶紧开始比赛吧！这简直在破坏我的专注力！

lines.en: scene knowledge5
: And representing the second floor, we have Nodoka Nagasawa!
lines.zh: : 而代表二楼出战的，是 Nodoka Nagasawa！

lines.en: : As you can tell, she likes coffee! But don’t let that fool you! Her drink of choice is tomato juice and she needs to drink it every two hours or she will die!
lines.zh: : 大家都知道，她喜欢咖啡！但别被这个骗了！她真正爱喝的是番茄汁，而且每两小时就得喝一次，不然她会死！

lines.en: : She also spends her free time singing the “Happy Birthday” song to herself in the mirror and-
lines.zh: : 她还会在空闲时对着镜子给自己唱“生日快乐”歌，而且——

lines.en: : Wait, Uta, I can’t say this part.
lines.zh: : 等等，Uta，这部分我说不出口。

lines.en: : Hm? What’s wrong? Did I put somethin’ weird in her intro?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？我在她的介绍里写了什么奇怪的东西吗？

lines.en: scene knowledge6
: Well, not weird but...I don’t think it’s true that her and Futaba are having a baby.
lines.zh: : 倒也不是奇怪……只是我觉得她和 Futaba 要生孩子这件事应该不是真的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，什么？

lines.en: : It’s true. We are deeply in love and I am carrying her child.
lines.zh: : 是真的。我们深爱着彼此，而我现在怀着她的孩子。

lines.en: : Enough with these weird introductions! Just hurry up and start asking the questions!
lines.zh: : 这些奇怪的介绍够了！赶紧开始提问吧！

lines.en: : Jeez, Makoto. You’re really fired up now, huh?
lines.zh: : 天啊，Makoto。你现在是真的燃起来了啊？

lines.en: scene knowledge7
: Of course I am. We’re still coming off a loss from the last round and I need to prove to everyone that Nodoka is no smarter than I am.
lines.zh: : 那当然。上一轮我们刚输掉，我得向大家证明 Nodoka 并不比我聪明。

lines.en: : Since Makoto is rarin' to go, let’s get right down to it!
lines.zh: : 既然 Makoto 已经摩拳擦掌了，那我们就直奔主题！

lines.en: : In order to keep things fair, I’ll be asking the questions to Makoto and Ami will be asking the questions to Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 为了保证公平，我来向 Makoto 提问，Ami 来向 Nodoka 提问。

lines.en: scene knowledge8
: So, Makoto...
lines.zh: : 那么，Makoto……

lines.en: : Cells can be defined as either eu...eukary...otic or-
lines.zh: : 细胞可以分为真……真核……或者——

lines.en: : Prokaryotic. Next question.
lines.zh: : 原核。下一题。

lines.en: : Heck yeah! We win!
lines.zh: : 太棒了！我们赢啦！

lines.en: : Wait, no. Hold on. I didn’t even finish reading the question.
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。等一下。我还没把题目念完呢。

lines.en: : Cells can be either...eukaroyotic or...that thing Makoto said. But which of these categories does bacteria fall into?
lines.zh: : 细胞可以是……真核或者……Makoto 说的那个东西。但细菌属于其中哪一类？

lines.en: : That would be...
lines.zh: : 那应该是……

lines.en: : Prokaryotic. All bacteria are unicellular.
lines.zh: : 原核。所有细菌都是单细胞生物。

lines.en: : That is...
lines.zh: : 答案是……

lines.en: scene knowledge9
: Correct! First point goes to Makoto!
lines.zh: : 正确！第一分归 Makoto！

lines.en: : That question wasn’t really that hard, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那题其实没多难吧。

lines.en: : The heck you talkin’ about, Maya? I’ve never even heard like half of those words before.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊，Maya？那些词我有一半听都没听过。

lines.en: : Well then you should probably pay more attention in class, as we have definitely studied them.
lines.zh: : 那你可能该在课上更认真点，因为这些我们肯定学过。

lines.en: scene knowledge5
: Okay! So now that the first floor is on the board, it’s time for Nodoka’s first question, I guess...
lines.zh: : 好的！既然一楼已经得分了，那我猜……该轮到 Nodoka 的第一题了……

lines.en: : Let’s see...umm...
lines.zh: : 让我看看……呃……

lines.en: : Nodoka, who is the only US president to ever get married inside of the White House?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，哪位美国总统是唯一一个在白宫里面结婚的？

lines.en: : Attack!
lines.zh: : 进攻！

lines.en: : This is a passive battle, Kendo Princess. There will be no attacks.
lines.zh: : 这是场非对抗性的比赛，剑道公主。不可以进攻。

lines.en: : Then the other team will not see it coming! Go! Fight! Win!
lines.zh: : 那对方队伍就料不到了！冲啊！战斗！取胜！

lines.en: : Umm...
: Chuck E. Cheese?
lines.zh: : Chuck E. Cheese？

lines.en: : Wha-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: : Uhh...no. The answer is actually Grover Cleveland.
lines.zh: : 呃……不对。正确答案其实是 Grover Cleveland。

lines.en: : Oooooh, right. Silly me, always confusing those two things.
lines.zh: : 哦——对哦。我真是笨，老把这两样搞混。

lines.en: : That’s fine! You can get one or two wrong! Shake it off, Nodoka!
lines.zh: : 没关系！错一两题也行！别放在心上，Nodoka！

lines.en: scene knowledge10
: Uhh...what are you doing?
lines.zh: : 呃……你在干什么？

lines.en: : What do you mean, class representative?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思，班长？

lines.en: : I mean that if you don’t know the answer to a problem, don’t just throw a random one at it to make it look like you’re getting it wrong on purpose.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果你不知道某道题的答案，就别随便丢个答案上去，好显得你是故意答错的。

lines.en: : Either take this seriously or just concede now.
lines.zh: : 要么认真点，要么现在就认输。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Sorry. I’ll try harder next time. Promise.
lines.zh: : 好好好。抱歉。下次我会更努力的。保证。

lines.en: : Right! Well, to keep things moving...
lines.zh: : 好的！那么，为了继续推进……

lines.en: scene knowledge11
: Makoto, if you had to give a name to the...parallel latitude approximately 23 degrees north of the equator, what would it be?
lines.zh: : Makoto，如果让你给赤道以北大约 23 度的……那条纬线起个名字，你会叫它什么？

lines.en: : Are you...asking me to personally give it a name of my choosing? Or are you asking me what it’s called?
lines.zh: : 你是……要我个人给它起个我自己选的名字？还是在问我它叫什么？

lines.en: : That question wasn’t worded properly.
lines.zh: : 这题的措辞不对。

lines.en: : Well excuse me, princess. What’s that place called?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，恕我冒犯，公主殿下。那地方叫什么？

lines.en: : The...Tropic of Cancer, I think?
lines.zh: : 是……北回归线吧？

lines.en: : That is...
lines.zh: : 答案是……

lines.en: scene knowledge12
: Correct again! Another point for the first floor, even though Makoto snapped at me!
lines.zh: : 又答对了！一楼再得一分，虽然 Makoto 刚才还冲我发火！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Uta. I’m just a little caught up in the moment right now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Uta。我只是有点太投入了。

lines.en: scene knowledge13
: See? That one was a little harder, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？那题稍微难一点了，对吧？

lines.en: : It was. But it’s still nothing compared to a lot of the stuff Ayane and I came up with for Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过比起我和 Ayane 给 Nodoka 准备的那些题，还是小巫见大巫。

lines.en: : I can’t see Makoto losing if she’s just going to keep getting questions with precise answers that she’s already memorized.
lines.zh: : 要是 Makoto 一直拿到她早就背下来的、答案明确的题目，我看不出她怎么会输。

lines.en: : Well, I...wouldn’t be so sure about that. Nodoka's really smart.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……可不会这么肯定。Nodoka 真的很聪明。

lines.en: : So...I’d wait another round or two before passing judgement...
lines.zh: : 所以……我会再等一两轮再下结论……

lines.en: scene knowledge14
: Nodoka, what is the correct scientific name of the “zombie fungus” that infects and controls the minds of insects, most commonly ants?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，那种会感染并控制昆虫（最常见的是蚂蚁）思维的“僵尸真菌”，正确的学名是什么？

lines.en: : Oh! Oh! I know this! I actually know this!
lines.zh: : 哦！哦！我知道这个！我真的知道！

lines.en: : I played a game inspired by that!
lines.zh: : 我玩过一个受它启发的游戏！

lines.en: : Hmm...zombie fungus...
lines.zh: : 嗯……僵尸真菌……

lines.en: : What do I know about zombie fungus?...
lines.zh: : 我对僵尸真菌了解些什么呢？……

lines.en: : Portobello mushrooms?
lines.zh: : 波托贝洛蘑菇？

lines.en: scene knowledge15
: We got a point!
lines.zh: : 我们得分了！

lines.en: : No we didn’t, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 不，我们没有，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : The correct answer was {i}Ophiocordyceps.{/i}
lines.zh: : 正确答案是 {i}Ophiocordyceps{/i}。

lines.en: : I am glad Molly said that because I could definitely not pronounce it.
lines.zh: : 幸好是 Molly 说的，因为那个我是绝对念不出来的。

lines.en: : Oh, how wonderful it must be to have your brain invaded by fungus.
lines.zh: : 哦，能让真菌侵入自己的大脑，该有多美妙啊。

lines.en: : Think of all the possibilities that would open up for you if you did not have to use up your energy on performing basic functions and allowed a parasite to take over instead?
lines.zh: : 想想看，如果你不必把精力耗费在维持基本机能上，而是让寄生虫来接管，那会为你打开多少种可能？

lines.en: scene knowledge16
: So, do you like, {i}only{/i} play chaotic characters? Or do you branch out into different stuff sometimes?
lines.zh: : 那么，你{i}只{/i}扮演混乱阵营的角色吗？还是偶尔也会尝试别的类型？

lines.en: : I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: scene knowledge17
: I can’t believe I’m saying this...but good job, Makoto! Keep it up and we’ll have another victory in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己会这么说……不过干得好，Makoto！照这样下去，我们很快又能赢一场。

lines.en: : I’d like to say the same to Nodoka, but apparently her weird encyclopedia brain is taking a nap right now.
lines.zh: : 我也想对 Nodoka 说同样的话，不过显然她那颗奇怪的百科全书大脑这会儿正在打瞌睡。

lines.en: : Oh, gosh darn it. I could have sworn I had that one.
lines.zh: : 哦，可恶。我明明以为那题我是会的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Uta. I’m trying my best over here.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Uta。我已经在这边尽力了。

lines.en: : Well your best friggin’ sucks right now! Ante up or we won’t get extra Sensei time at the beach!
lines.zh: : 可你现在的“尽力”烂透了！加把劲，不然我们在海边就别想多争取到 Sensei 的时间了！

lines.en: scene knowledge18
: Just give up on that now, Uta. None of us intend to let you have Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你现在就死了这条心吧，Uta。我们谁都不打算把 Sensei 让给你们。

lines.en: : Especially not when {i}we’d{/i} be losing out on him in the process.
lines.zh: : 更别提{i}我们{/i}还会因此失去他。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how valuable of an asset his time has become among the first floor girls?
lines.zh: : 你知道他的时间在一楼女生眼里已经变成多宝贵的资产了吗？

lines.en: : It’s essentially its own form of currency now.
lines.zh: : 现在它基本上已经自成一派，成了一种货币。

lines.en: : Watch it, Makoto! You might be winning, but he’s still {i}my{/i} [uncle] and he’d never date a weirdo with glasses!
lines.zh: : 说话注意点，Makoto！你也许是赢了，可他还是{i}我的{/i}[uncle]，他才不会跟一个戴眼镜的怪人交往！

lines.en: : Then...was what happened between him and me in the cafe bathroom a lie?
lines.zh: : 那么……我和他在咖啡店洗手间里发生的事，是假的吗？

lines.en: : My fragile [teenage]heart...to be tossed aside after my first time is-
lines.zh: : 我那颗脆弱的[teenage]心……在我的第一次之后就被抛弃了，这——

lines.en: : Next question, please.
lines.zh: : 下一题，谢谢。

lines.en: : Got it! But just so ya know, this is where things start heating up!
lines.zh: : 收到！不过你们要知道，从现在开始才是真正的白热化！

lines.en: : The questions you guys got have just been warm-ups so far.
lines.zh: : 你们刚才拿到的那些题，到目前为止都只是热身。

lines.en: : For the rest of the questions, teams from both floors got together and just started Googling a bunch of super hard stuff that none of you would probably ever know.
lines.zh: : 剩下的题，两层的队伍凑在一起，直接上网搜了一堆你们大概一辈子都不会知道的超级难题。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Here we go.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。来了。

lines.en: : Well then I’ve basically won already, haven’t I?
lines.zh: : 那我基本上已经赢了吧，不是吗？

lines.en: : Looks like Nodoka has learned a valuable lesson today about taking even the first rounds of a competition seriously.
lines.zh: : 看来 Nodoka 今天学到了宝贵的一课：哪怕是比赛的第一轮也得认真对待。

lines.en: : Hey. Settle down or I’ll be forced to come over there and lick you.
lines.zh: : 嘿。冷静点，不然我就不得不过去舔你了。

lines.en: : Run, Makoto! I’ll hold her off!
lines.zh: : 快跑，Makoto！我来挡住她！

lines.en: : A genius never runs from...knowledge.
lines.zh: : 天才永远不会逃离……知识。

lines.en: : Inspiring.
lines.zh: : 令人振奋。

lines.en: : Just ask the next question already.
lines.zh: : 赶紧问下一题吧。

lines.en: : Got it!
lines.zh: : 收到！

lines.en: : Makoto! What is the scientific name of the oldest potted plant in the world and where is it located?
lines.zh: : Makoto！世界上现存最古老的盆栽植物学名叫什么，又在哪里？

lines.en: scene knowledge19
: Oh. So you’re literally just going to ask questions that are impossible to answer.
lines.zh: : 哦。所以你们是真的打算问些根本不可能答上来的题。

lines.en: : Not even going to guess?
lines.zh: : 连猜都不猜？

lines.en: : And say what? Chuck E. Cheese or portobello mushrooms? No thanks.
lines.zh: : 然后说什么？Chuck E. Cheese 还是波托贝洛蘑菇？谢了，不用。

lines.en: : I’m proud enough to accept when I don’t know the answer to something, and I’m not going to trick everyone into thinking I’m just throwing the question away.
lines.zh: : 我有足够的自尊去承认自己不知道某件事的答案，也不打算骗大家，好让人以为我只是随手放弃了这道题。

lines.en: : Can I try?
lines.zh: : 我可以试试吗？

lines.en: scene knowledge20
: I mean...sure. If you want to continue wasting everyone’s time, be my guest.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……当然。如果你想继续浪费大家的时间，请便。

lines.en: : You can try, but...since it’s not your question, I don’t think you should get any points for it.
lines.zh: : 你可以试，不过……因为这不是你的题，我觉得你不该因此得分。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I don’t need any points for knowing that the oldest potted plant in the world is the Kew Gardens’ encephalartos altensteinii.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我知道世界上最古老的盆栽是邱园的 encephalartos altensteinii，这并不需要分数。

lines.en: : Um...well I don’t have the card, so-
lines.zh: : 呃……可我手上没有答案卡，所以——

lines.en: : Damn it, Nodoka! How come you can answer her questions but not your own?!
lines.zh: : 可恶，Nodoka！为什么你能答出她的题，却答不出自己的？！

lines.en: : Wait, was that the correct answer?
lines.zh: : 等等，那是正确答案吗？

lines.en: : I can’t read the whole word but...probably!
lines.zh: : 这个单词我读不全，不过……大概是！

lines.en: : Give me the card. Let me see.
lines.zh: : 把卡给我。让我看看。

lines.en: : What if I just hold it up like this? Can you see it from there?
lines.zh: : 我就这么举着行吗？你从那儿看得见吗？

lines.en: : I can see that she’s likely just guessing a-
lines.zh: : 我看出来了，她很可能只是在猜——

lines.en: : Wait, no. That’s correct.
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。那是正确的。

lines.en: : Yaaaaaaay. Now get over here and let me lick you..
lines.zh: : 耶————。现在过来让我舔你吧……

lines.en: scene knowledge21
: Welp, here we go. Makoto’s screwed unless she’s somehow also another fountain of knowledge.
lines.zh: : 唉，来了。除非 Makoto 也是一座知识的喷泉，不然她完了。

lines.en: : What do you mean?  Nodoka doesn’t even have any points yet. And even if she was doing it on purpose, she’s gotten both of her questions wrong so far.
lines.zh: : 什么意思？Nodoka 到现在一分都没有。就算她是故意的，她那两道题也全答错了啊。

lines.en: : Yeah. She tries to throw everyone off of her trail by pretending to be less smart than she actually is when it comes to stuff like this.
lines.zh: : 是啊。碰到这种事，她会装得比实际笨，好把所有人都从她的线索上引开。

lines.en: : But the truth is that she actually loves the spotlight and was just waiting for the right time to step into it.
lines.zh: : 但事实是，她其实很喜欢出风头，只是在等一个合适的时机站上去而已。

lines.en: : Why are you two standing next to me just half an hour after ruining my morning?
lines.zh: : 你们俩刚毁了我的早晨，才过半小时就站到我旁边来了，是何居心？

lines.en: scene knowledge22
: We’re here to make you feel better!
lines.zh: : 我们是来让你好受一点的！

lines.en: : Hang in there, bud. It’s not like it’s impossible to escape the friend zone.
lines.zh: : 撑住啊，老兄。又不是不可能从朋友区里爬出来。

lines.en: : Exactly! Just because you had to deal with us being kinda mean to you for a few minutes doesn’t mean it’ll always be like that.
lines.zh: : 没错！你只是得忍受我们对你刻薄了几分钟，不代表以后一直都会这样。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Like, who knows? Maybe you and Otoha will go back to your place after this contest and just completely toss me out of the picture because my feelings don’t actually matter to you.
lines.zh: : 比如说，谁知道呢？也许这场比赛结束后，你和 Otoha 会一起回你家，然后彻底把我踢出局，因为我的感受对你来说根本不重要。

lines.en: : That would be like, so crazy, right? Hahahah.
lines.zh: : 那可真是太离谱了，对吧？哈哈哈。

lines.en: scene knowledge23
: Uhh...no. That would be pretty horrible.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。那可就太可怕了。

lines.en: else:
: Like, I don’t even really consider you in the friend zone for me. You’re just Sensei and I’m just Rin.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我其实根本没把你当成我的朋友区里的人。你就是 Sensei，我就是 Rin。

lines.en: : We’re friends, but like-
lines.zh: : 我们是朋友，不过就是——

lines.en: : But you’ve also kissed and he’s seen your boobs before.
lines.zh: : 可你们还接过吻，而且他还看过你的胸。

lines.en: : Yeah. That.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这个。

lines.en: : And I also was a {i}clear{/i} loser today, so...maybe that’s saying something?
lines.zh: : 而且我今天输得{i}明明白白{/i}，所以……也许这说明点什么？

lines.en: : It’s saying you both should probably shoot a little closer to your respective age groups and-
lines.zh: : 这说明你们俩大概都该把目标放得离各自年龄层近一点，然后——

lines.en: : Shut up, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴吧，Otoha。

lines.en: : Aight.
lines.zh: : 行吧。

lines.en: scene knowledge20
: Okay, Nodoka...your next question is-
lines.zh: : 好的，Nodoka……你的下一题是——

lines.en: : In what year did Roger Tory Peterson first release his famous “A Field Guide to the Birds?” and by which company was it published?
lines.zh: : Roger Tory Peterson 那本著名的《鸟类野外指南》是在哪一年首次出版的？由哪家公司发行？

lines.en: : You expect me to know the release year and publishing company of an ornithologist’s field guide?
lines.zh: : 你指望我知道一位鸟类学家的野外指南的出版年份和发行公司？

lines.en: : Well, no...but-
lines.zh: : 嗯，倒不是……不过——

lines.en: : Because I do. It was published in 1934 by the Houghton Mifflin company. There are actually several copies kept at the Joseph F. Cullman 3rd Library of Natural History, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: : 因为我还真知道。它于 1934 年由 Houghton Mifflin 公司出版。顺便一提，Joseph F. Cullman 第三自然史图书馆里还保存着好几本。

lines.en: : Books are cool.
lines.zh: : 书真棒。

lines.en: : Who’s idea was it to ask her a literature question?! She clearly only knows the answer to that because it’s a key interest of hers.
lines.zh: : 是谁出的主意问她文学题的？！她会答上来，显然只是因为那是她的主要兴趣所在。

lines.en: : Right. Just like the encephalartos altensteinii.
lines.zh: : 对。就像那个 encephalartos altensteinii 一样。

lines.en: : I have very specific interests.
lines.zh: : 我的兴趣非常专一。

lines.en: scene knowledge24
: Wow. That Nodoka girl really isn’t messin’ around anymore, is she?
lines.zh: : 哇。那个 Nodoka 是真的不闹着玩了啊？

lines.en: : She just had a lucky streak of knowing two answers in a row. It’s nothing to write home about.
lines.zh: : 她只是运气好，连续撞对两题而已。没什么了不起的。

lines.en: : Then, here’s a question a math whiz like you should be able to handle easily, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 那么，来一道像你这样的数学天才应该能轻松搞定的题吧，Makoto！

lines.en: : No bells or whistles, just a straight up calculationy problem.
lines.zh: : 不玩花活，就是一道纯粹的计算题。

lines.en: : Makoto Miyamura! What is the answer to...584 divided by 39?
lines.zh: : Makoto Miyamura！……584 除以 39 等于多少？

lines.en: scene knowledge25
: That’s...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : It would be approximately...15?
: That is...
lines.zh: : 答案是……

lines.en: scene knowledge26
: Correct!
lines.zh: : 正确！

lines.en: : Ha! I-
: Kind of!
lines.zh: : 勉强算对！

lines.en: : What do you mean, “kind of?”
lines.zh: : 什么叫“勉强”？

lines.en: : It says here that I need at least the first three decimal points since it’s not {i}technically{/i} 15.
lines.zh: : 这上面写着，因为它{i}严格来说{/i}不是 15，所以至少要答到小数点后三位。

lines.en: : Of course it’s not {i}technically{/i} 15, but expecting someone to be able to do specific math like that without a calculator is-
lines.zh: : 它当然{i}严格来说{/i}不是 15，可指望有人不用计算器就能算出那么精确的结果，这——

lines.en: : Next question please.
lines.zh: : 下一题，谢谢。

lines.en: scene knowledge27
: That...
: She’s wrong, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她是错的吧？

lines.en: : Nodoka is correct!
lines.zh: : Nodoka 答对了！

lines.en: : Unfortunately, the point can not go to her since it was not her question. But at least we’ve all learned something today!
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，因为这不是她的题，这一分不能给她。不过至少我们今天都学到了点东西！

lines.en: scene black
{i}Roughly ten minutes later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大约十分钟后……{/i}

lines.en: scene knowledge28
: So...Nodoka has nine questions right and Makoto has four.
lines.zh: : 那么……Nodoka 答对了九题，Makoto 四题。

lines.en: : Which means if Nodoka can get this one right, the game is over.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，只要 Nodoka 这题答对，比赛就结束了。

lines.en: : That girl is not human.
lines.zh: : 那女孩不是人类。

lines.en: : This contest is rigged! Somebody’s been feedin’ Nodoka the answers! Nobody is that smart!
lines.zh: : 这场比赛有黑幕！有人在给 Nodoka 泄题！没人能那么聪明！

lines.en: : Just...let her ask the next question, Miku.
lines.zh: : 别说了……让她问下一题吧，Miku。

lines.en: : Nodoka...to win the game-
lines.zh: : Nodoka……为了赢下这场比赛——

lines.en: : What is the proper scientific name for “brain freeze?”
lines.zh: : “脑冻结”的正确学名是什么？

lines.en: scene knowledge29
: Before I win, there is something I would like to say to clear the air.
lines.zh: : 在获胜之前，我想说几句话，把话说清楚。

lines.en: : Okay, but make it quick! I’ve gotta get over to work for my rap battle with Ayane like, as soon as this is over.
lines.zh: : 行，不过长话短说！这场一结束我就得赶去上班，和 Ayane 说唱对决。

lines.en: scene knowledge30
: Makoto, you are a very impressive [young_girl] with a wide array of skills and talents at your disposal.
lines.zh: : Makoto，你是一位非常出色的[young_girl]，掌握着各式各样的技能与才华。

lines.en: : And, under most circumstances, I would have been fine with allowing you to win.
lines.zh: : 而且在大多数情况下，我本来乐意让你赢的。

lines.en: : However, not only do I feel that doing so would greatly offend you, but we are competing for a prize I would very much like to have.
lines.zh: : 然而，我不仅觉得那样做会严重冒犯到你，而且我们争夺的奖品，我本人也非常想要得到。

lines.en: : So do not let my victory derail you from your path to greatness, but-
lines.zh: : 所以，别让我的胜利把你从通往伟大的道路上带偏，不过——

lines.en: : Okay, time’s up! Tell us the answer or we’re going back to Makoto and-
lines.zh: : 好了，时间到！告诉我们答案，不然我们就回到 Makoto 那边——

lines.en: scene knowledge31
: Sphenopalatine Ganglioneuralgia.
lines.zh: : Sphenopalatine Ganglioneuralgia。

lines.en: : Emerald Guardian! Call the ambulance! She is having a stroke!
lines.zh: : 翡翠守卫！叫救护车！她中风了！

lines.en: : Ami? The verdict?
lines.zh: : Ami？判定结果？

lines.en: : Uhh...I think she’s right?...
lines.zh: : 呃……我觉得她是对的？……

lines.en: : Take a look at the card. What do you think?
lines.zh: : 你看看答案卡。你觉得呢？

lines.en: : Let me see...
lines.zh: : 让我看看……

lines.en: : Yup! Looks good to me!
lines.zh: : 嗯！我看没问题！

lines.en: : The winner of the knowledge contest is Nodoka Nagasawa of the second floor!
lines.zh: : 知识大赛的获胜者是二楼的 Nodoka Nagasawa！

lines.en: scene knowledge32
: Hey...it’s okay, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 嘿……没关系，Makoto。

lines.en: : Even the best teams in sports can lose to worse ones sometimes. One loss doesn’t mean you’re no good.
lines.zh: : 就算是最好的队伍，在体育比赛里有时也会输给差一点的。输一次不代表你不行。

lines.en: : You’re still one of the smartest people in the[school]. Who cares if we lost a point in this round? We can just get it back later.
lines.zh: : 你仍然是[school]里最聪明的人之一。这一轮丢了一分又怎样？我们之后赢回来就是了。

lines.en: : I don’t really care about the points, Miku. I wanted to win this for me.
lines.zh: : 我其实不在乎分数，Miku。我是想为自己赢下这场。

lines.en: : Well then we can...go win somethin’ else for you! It’s not the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 那我们就……去为你赢点别的！又不是世界末日。

lines.en: : Yeah...you did great, Makoto. No one has ever even put up a fight with Nodoka before, so...
lines.zh: : 是啊……你已经很棒了，Makoto。以前从来没有人能和 Nodoka 抗衡过，所以……

lines.en: : That wasn’t a fight. That was a bloodbath.
lines.zh: : 那不叫抗衡。那叫血洗。

lines.en: : She...played with me before wiping the floor with me. It wasn’t even close.
lines.zh: : 她……先玩弄了我一番，然后把我打得落花流水。根本不是一个量级的。

lines.en: scene knowledge33
: Okay! Anyone who isn’t coming to the maid cafe for the next contest, please clean up the library!
lines.zh: : 好了！不去女仆咖啡店参加下一场比赛的人，请留下来打扫图书馆！

lines.en: : Anyone who is, form a single file conga line behind Sensei and start gettin’ your butt into gear! Move, move, move!
lines.zh: : 要去的，在 Sensei 后面排成一条康加舞长队，赶紧动起来！快，快，快！

lines.en: : Sensei! Let’s conga!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我们来跳康加舞！

lines.en: : Please leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 请让我一个人待着。

lines.en: scene black
I watch Makoto as the rest of the girls begin to either pack up their things or...start doing the conga.
lines.zh: 其他女生要么开始收拾东西，要么……开始跳康加舞，而我看着 Makoto。

lines.en: I think about going over to try and cheer her up but, frankly, if I were in her position, I’d want to be left alone right now.
lines.zh: 我想过去试着安慰她，不过说实话，如果我处在她的位置，现在应该也会想一个人待着。

lines.en: It can’t be easy being so confident in something and then having to helplessly flail about when it comes time to show everyone {i}why{/i} you were confident.
lines.zh: 对自己充满信心，却在要向大家证明信心{i}从何{/i}而来时无力地挣扎，这一定不好受。

lines.en: But it wasn’t like any amount of studying could have prepared Makoto for a test like that in the first place.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，再怎么复习，Makoto 本来也不可能为那样一场测验做好准备。

lines.en: The fact that she was even able to get two of the more ridiculous questions just goes to show how smart she actually is.
lines.zh: 她甚至连两道相当离谱的题都答对了，这恰恰说明她有多聪明。

lines.en: : Sensei, will you be joining us at the hotel tonight?
lines.zh: : Sensei，您今晚要来酒店和我们汇合吗？

lines.en: : Hotel?
lines.zh: : 酒店？

lines.en: : No one told you?
lines.zh: : 没人告诉您吗？

lines.en: : Ayane and Touka re-booked the hotel we stayed at for our Christmas trip.
lines.zh: : Ayane 和 Touka 重新预订了我们圣诞旅行时住的那家酒店。

lines.en: : I’m tired and don’t know anything about rap music, so I’m going to go take a nap there.
lines.zh: : 我累了，而且对说唱音乐一窍不通，所以打算去那儿睡个午觉。

lines.en: : Didn’t you just drink like eight cups of coffee?
lines.zh: : 你不是刚喝了大概八杯咖啡吗？

lines.en: : So what? I’ve been walking back and forth all day. I am {i}very{/i} tired.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？我一整天都在来回走。我{i}很{/i}累。

lines.en: : You should come hang out with us later when you’re done being a prize for everyone.
lines.zh: : 等您当完所有人的奖品，待会儿应该过来跟我们玩。

lines.en: : You can hear more about the baby Futaba and I are having together.
lines.zh: : 您可以多听听我和 Futaba 要生的那个孩子的事。

lines.en: : Please...stop telling people we’re going to have a baby...
lines.zh: : 拜托……别再跟人说我们要生孩子了……

lines.en: $ dormwar6 = True
$ dorm2warpoints += 1
Floor 1: [dorm1warpoints]\nFloor 2: [dorm2warpoints]
lines.zh:
一楼：[dorm1warpoints]
